title: KYield proposes AI-supported prevention of human-caused catastrophes
summary: KYield proposes HumCat for organizational risk prevention, but the reviewed sources do not document a catastrophe that it prevented.
account: KYield announced HumCat on July 18, 2017. Its release describes a distributed AI system operating within organizational workflows and a prevention program that could be combined with insurance or catastrophe bonds. A later founder account describes risk mitigation and performance guarantees as proposed commercial features. Neither source supplies a named customer, observed avoided catastrophe, evaluation design, or quantified realized loss reduction.
purpose: HumCat is intended to detect organizational risks and prevent human-caused catastrophes.
system: HumCat, powered by the Kyield Operating System (KOS)
domain: Organizational risk management and catastrophe prevention
